title: Nehan Shōja
body:
Syntax: perform nehan shouja

Description: Attempts to put eligible enemies in the room to sleep for 12 seconds; safe rooms prevent hostile PvP. Put eligible enemies in your room to sleep for 12 seconds, each with an independent resistance check; no friendly fire or PvP in safe rooms. Usable with any chakra nature. Unlocks at level 65. Costs 60 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 20 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
